targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "gas")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "gas_real")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediccion" and r._field == "gas")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "gas_prediccion")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "gas")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and (r._field == "distancia" or r._field == "sonido"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensores")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "agente")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
